review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (an interior/exterior renovation, Missouri, project T2504), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during the same batch-survey pass that also found lambda-sa-m403.json. Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.00 on this sheet. Sheet M-104 is drawn in a genuinely different, notably clean style from most of this session's other real-corpus finds: real DOUBLE-LINE duct (both walls of the duct drawn as parallel strokes, not a single centerline), with dimension callouts printed directly on the duct itself -- one of the most legible real drawings found this session.

A text-anchor scan found 75 bare `WxH"` rectangular duct callouts on this one sheet alone (no `(E)` prefix, no system suffix, already fully parseable with no grammar change needed). A grid sweep of ten of them found this real, clean 4.34 LF vertical duct riser: `size:{kind:rect,w_in:12,h_in:10}`, confidence 0.5, `factors:["stroke-family:pen-weight-prior","size-binding:beside","ambiguous_stop","layer-unclassified","scale_unconfirmed"]`. A marked crop confirms it visually and unambiguously: a real double-line vertical duct labeled '12"x10"' directly on the run, connecting a real branch-tee junction at the top (where two 6"x6" grille branches split off through 8"x6" transition boots) to a real transition point at the bottom (just above where the duct continues, at a different size, further down past an S2/150 CFM diffuser tag) -- both real, visually-confirmed junction/transition points, not engine misreads, matching this corpus's own established ambiguous-stop-at-a-real-junction convention. `resolveRunSegments` reproduces the identical single 4.34 LF segment and a reseed `trace_run` from the same known-good seed against the freshly re-loaded, already-committed raw PDF reproduces identical points, length, and size exactly.

This sheet has a second, independent riser of the same overall style and quality authored alongside this one (see `t2504-sa-m104-riser2.json`, a `16"x11"` riser elsewhere on the same sheet) -- both verified from the same batch-sweep pass since this sheet's drawing quality made both efficient to confirm.
scope: A single real 12x10-inch rectangular duct riser segment (4.34 LF) on the T2504 renovation project's own mechanical plan, sheet M-104, from a real branch-tee junction (feeding two 6"x6" grille takeoffs) down to a real size-transition point above where the duct continues at a different size. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the duct's own continuation past either boundary; the parallel 16"x8" duct run visible in the same crop; the second riser authored separately on this same sheet (`t2504-sa-m104-riser2.json`); every other one of the 75 real duct-size callouts found on this same sheet, not attempted this pass; every other sheet on this real 51-sheet plan set.
